API Reference › Image Library

labkit.image.grayWorldWhiteBalance

Apply generic gray-world white balance.

Syntax

function imageOut = grayWorldWhiteBalance(imageIn, strengthPct, temperaturePct)

Usage

imageOut = labkit.image.grayWorldWhiteBalance(imageIn, strengthPct, temperaturePct)

Inputs

imageIn
numeric image data, normalized internally to RGB double.
strengthPct
blend strength from 0 to 100.
temperaturePct
optional warm/cool red-blue offset in percent.

Outputs

imageOut
RGB double image clamped to [0, 1].
